name: Adrenaline & the alarm system

overlay.caption: brain spots a challenge → adrenaline → heart, sweat, mouth all change at once

does: Shows one signal (adrenaline) changing several body systems at the same time
Shows the response scaling with how big the moment feels, not with any real danger
Shows everything settling back within minutes once the moment passes (halving every 5 minutes)
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Say anything about anxiety, panic or any condition; this is the everyday pre-performance response
Model what happens with long-lasting stress
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Nerves before a big moment are normal and pass. If worry gets in the way of everyday life, talk with an adult you trust.

sources: CK-12 Life Science: endocrine system, adrenal glands
NIH News in Health: the stress response (student overview)
